column1: # AC-M1.1 edge set (PLAN section 8, S3 close-out 2026-11-07): 54 prompts over rashomon pre-registered on
# 2026-11-07 02:4x before any T1c engine change, seventeen prompt classes (feature-add, bug-symptom, refactor,
# question, vague, multi-task, tests-only, performance, delete, cross-cutting, pasted-error, non-go, negation,
# knowledge-id, named-name, named-path, greenfield). Columns: id, unit, allow, prompt. unit: ';' separates the
# units any of which is right, '-' means no unit line is right; allow '*' leaves clause 2 (off-task lines)
# unjudged, no allow list was pre-registered for these rows; '\n' in a prompt is a newline. The truths have one
# author (the 11-07 session) read against the tree. Second read 2026-11-07 11:35: three Sonnet readers per prompt,
# blind to the engine and to the author (request text and the package list only); 49 of 59 unique prompts over this
# file and prompts.tsv confirmed, 10 contested, Fleiss kappa 0.928. Three truths revised on tree facts: O1 to
# internal/recap (the Stop line is composed in internal/recap/recap.go and clause.go over verify.StopView, printed by
# cmd/rashomon/recap_stop.go; internal/recap imports nothing from internal/steer/render); N2 gains internal/recap
# (les:B386 applies to both units in the graph); I4 gains '-' (the first task is a rebase that no unit owns). Seven
# stand with the fact that settles each (PL12, A2, J2: platformRow, ObligationUnknown and the obligation ledger are
# internal/verify/platform.go and obligations.go; B2: the piped-run shape is internal/shape/masked*.go; B4: the reaper
# is a 13-line main calling peakrss.Reap; N1: req:PF-PL12 applies to pgraph/doc.go; ST12 in prompts.tsv: the readers
# named internal/graph/session, which the indexed tree does not hold). The class of each row is the letter series
# (A feature-add, B bug-symptom, C refactor, D delete, E tests-only, F performance, G non-go, H question, I multi-task,
# J named-name J2 J3 J5 and named-path J1 J4, K vague, L greenfield, M cross-cutting, N knowledge-id, O negation,
# P pasted-error); classes.tsv carries it as a column.
